top_signals.title: Gold Edges Higher as Dollar Slips and US Bonds Stabilize
top_signals.summary: Gold rose as a selloff in US bonds eased and the greenback fell, relieving pressure on the precious metal after it fell the most in almost a month on Tuesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
